svg.title: V-14. Stakeholder needs and use cases (SysML v2 view needsUseCases)
svg.desc: Needs and use cases view generated from the SysML v2 model. Columns are the use cases UC-01 to UC-11, each a SysML v2 use case with LD-SDA as its subject. Three bands of rows: the actors that take part in each use case; the stakeholder needs SN-01 to SN-12 that each use case's objective requires, with the system requirements and safety goals that refine each need; and the functions F-01 to F-09 each use case performs.
